title: Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger

faq.q: What metallic contamination levels are guaranteed for Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger?
faq.a: Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger is manufactured to ensure metallic surface contamination below 1×10¹⁰ atoms/cm² for Fe, Cr, Ni, Cu, and Zn per SEMI F108. For gas line check in front-end processes, additional ICP-MS verification is available with detection limits to 1×10⁸ atoms/cm². Double VAR-melted starting stock ensures inclusion-free microstructure.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger?
faq.a: Each Titanium Gas Check Valve Plunger shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for gas line check.
